topic: DID (Data Identifier) Internal Parameter Data Identifiers for Day Running Light Control Reason
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific internal parameter data identifier related to the reason why the day running light was opened.

column_semantics.Short Name: The short name of the DID, which is 'DayRunngLghtOpenCtrlRsn' in this case.
column_semantics.Description: A brief description of the DID, indicating it relates to the 'reason for opening the day running light'.
column_semantics.Value Table: Lists the possible hexadecimal values and their corresponding meanings for the DID.
column_semantics.Default: The default value of the DID, which is '0x00'.
column_semantics.Remark: Additional information about the DID, such as storage details and the most recent reason.
column_semantics.ECU: The Electronic Control Unit responsible for this parameter, which is 'LHZ CU'.

core_entities.name: DayRunngLghtOpenCtrlRsn
core_entities.description: Internal parameter data identifier for the reason why the day running light was opened.

core_conditions.name: DayRunngLghtOpenCtrlRsn_0_None
core_conditions.description: No specific reason for the day running light being opened.

core_conditions.name: DayRunngLghtOpenCtrlRsn_1_SOARequestOn
core_conditions.description: The day running light was opened due to a Start-Of-Authorization (SOA) request.

core_conditions.name: DayRunngLghtOpenCtrlRsn_2_NotParkPosition

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the internal parameter data identifiers for tracking the reason behind the activation of the day running light. It can be used to verify that the ECU correctly logs and stores the most recent 10 reasons for the day running light being turned on, ensuring accurate diagnostic and maintenance records.
